            valid_points_list.append(candidate)
            # Update the numpy array of valid points for subsequent vectorized operations.
            # np.vstack creates a new array, which is an overhead but generally faster than
            # repeated list-to-array conversions for `valid_points_np`.
            valid_points_np = np.vstack([valid_points_np, candidate])
            current_max_norm_sq = hypothetical_max_norm_sq
            current_min_dist_sq = hypothetical_min_dist_sq
    
    return np.array(valid_points_list, dtype=int)
